_comment: Cross-engine parity fixture for resolving effective fade-in/out durations. Each fade is first clamped to [0, clipDuration]; if the two together still exceed the clip duration they are scaled down proportionally (by clipDuration / sum) so they meet at a point instead of overlapping and multiplying. Read by web test test/unit/utils/video-editor/audio-effective-fades.parity.test.ts (computeFadeDurationsSeconds, src/utils/audio/envelope.ts) AND Rust test audio::mix::tests::effective_fades_matches_shared_parity_fixture (effective_fades, src-tauri/src/audio/mix.rs). All durations in seconds. A zero/negative clip duration yields (0,0) on both sides.
